info.title: Theo Lens API
info.description: Tenant-isolated observability engine. Errors use the {code,message,details?} envelope. List responses are paginated as {items,total,limit,offset}. Query params are snake_case; JSON response fields are camelCase. A 400 covers both syntactic and semantic validation failures at the engine boundary (the edge/BFF maps browser-actionable upstreams separately).
